Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a chemical company based at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. Located in one of China’s most dynamic and economically active provinces, the company benefits from Hangzhou’s strong industrial base, modern transportation network, and access to a broad talent pool in science, engineering, and manufacturing. As a chemical new materials enterprise, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is positioned in a sector that plays an important role in supporting modern industry, from advanced manufacturing and consumer products to construction, electronics, and specialty applications.

Companies in the chemical new materials field typically focus on innovation, quality control, and product performance, and Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. operates within this landscape by serving the evolving needs of industrial customers and market partners. The company’s presence in Hangzhou also reflects the region’s growing emphasis on technology-driven development and environmentally responsible industrial transformation.

With the chemical and new materials industry continuing to expand, enterprises like Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. are increasingly important for supplying materials that help improve efficiency, durability, and functionality across many downstream sectors. Its location in Zhejiang places it within a strategic economic zone known for manufacturing strength, export activity, and business connectivity. Overall, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. represents a part of China’s broader industrial growth in chemicals and advanced materials, contributing to the development of modern solutions for a wide range of applications.
